{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Intensity Momentum", "construction": "Calculate the change in research and development expenses as a fraction of total assets over the past two years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with increasing R&D intensity may be more likely to innovate and experience future growth", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Advertising Expenditure Growth", "construction": "Compute the year-over-year growth rate of advertising expenses, sourced from annual reports and proxy statements", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing advertising expenditures may be expanding their market share and experiencing increasing brand recognition", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Fund Asset Allocation", "construction": "Use data from the Department of Labor to calculate the proportion of pension fund assets allocated to equity versus fixed income investments", "rationale": "Firms with pension funds that are more heavily invested in equities may be more sensitive to stock market fluctuations and experience higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "Calculate the change in inventory turnover, defined as cost of goods sold divided by average inventory, over the past three years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with accelerating inventory turnover may be experiencing improving operational efficiency and increasing competitiveness", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Rate", "construction": "Compute the year-over-year growth rate of total employees, sourced from Compustat and annual reports", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing workforces may be expanding their operations and experiencing increasing demand for their products or services", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Provision", "construction": "Use data from annual reports and proxy statements to calculate the provision for environmental liabilities as a fraction of total assets", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face increasing regulatory and reputational risks, leading to lower returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Foreign Sales Growth", "construction": "Compute the year-over-year growth rate of foreign sales, sourced from annual reports and Compustat", "rationale": "Firms with rapidly growing foreign sales may be expanding their global market share and experiencing increasing diversification benefits", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Suppliers' Credit Rating", "construction": "Use data from credit rating agencies to calculate the average credit rating of a firm's suppliers", "rationale": "Firms with suppliers that have high credit ratings may be less exposed to supply chain disruptions and experience higher returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Capital Expenditure Volatility", "construction": "Calculate the standard deviation of capital expenditures as a fraction of total assets over the past five years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high capital expenditure volatility may be more exposed to business cycle risks and experience lower returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Unionization Rate", "construction": "Use data from the Bureau of Labor Statistics to calculate the proportion of unionized employees, sourced from collective bargaining agreements and annual reports", "rationale": "Firms with high unionization rates may face increasing labor costs and experience lower returns", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
